events.prompt: I have a PDF emissions report for 2023. Where can I upload it so it becomes part of this city inventory?
events.body:
Ask Clima

Hello! I'm Clima, your virtual assistant. I'm here to guide you through the process of accurately measuring and reporting your city's greenhouse gas emissions. How can I assist you today?

I have a PDF emissions report for 2023. Where can I upload it so it becomes part of this city inventory?

Upload it in the Data Sources section of the 2023 city inventory:

Open the relevant city inventory (2023).
Go to Data Sources (or the sector/data-entry area where the emissions data belongs).
Choose Add data source / Upload document.
Attach the PDF and link it to the relevant sector(s) and activity/emissions fields.

A PDF report is typically retained as supporting evidence; its figures may still need to be entered or mapped into the inventory’s sector fields. If you tell me which inventory/city you’re working in, I can help identify the right place to add it.
